messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Latency SLO breach detected on streaming path (p99 > 6s). Auto-paging on-call.
Sam Oncall: Saw the page. Investigating now. p95 jumped from ~180ms -> 1.9s, p99 ~7.8s in the last 5m.
Maria SRE: Tracing shows preproc service (prompt-constructor) CPU at 95% and long GC pauses on two pods. Streaming tail requests are waiting on prompt rendering.
Kevin Eng: Poked the recent deploys — there was a template change rolled ~30m ago that expanded tool-schema introspection loops. Commit: f7b3a2d.
Jess Product: Customer impact: streaming timeouts for some long-format prompts; support tickets coming in from enterprise-corp-47 and analytics-startup. No data exfiltration, but user-visible latencies/timeouts.
Alex ML: The JSON-mode path does deep schema expansion for tool parameters now. If the prompt template set is large, tokenization + schema assembly can spike O(n^2) in the worst case. We're likely hitting that.
Sam Oncall: Can we get a quick short-term mitigation? Disable JSON-mode or roll back template change? Need to reduce p99 ASAP.
Kevin Eng: Suggestion: flip `enable_json_mode` for streaming route to false, and route heavy prompts to fallback model variant with simpler prompt path.
Maria SRE: I'll scale preproc pool by +3 nodes and drain the two highest-CPU pods for restart. Doing now.
Ops Bot: Executing scale: `rw infra scale preproc-pool --delta 3`
Ops Bot: Scaling started — nodes provisioning. ETA ~60s.
Maria SRE: Flipping feature flag to disable JSON-mode for streaming-route (canary first). Command: `flags set streaming.enable_json_mode false --env prod --scope streaming-route --no-wait`
Kevin Eng: Also posting a hotfix to short-circuit tool-schema expansion when templates > 12 tools. Patch pushed to canary. Hash: hotfix/shortcircuit-2026.
Sam Oncall: Rolling the flag globally if canary looks good. Anyone seeing immediate improvements in p95/p99?
Jess Product: Support says some customers report partial improvements; streaming failures reduced, but long tails still present for a subset.
Maria SRE: After scale + flag canary: p95 ~240ms, p99 ~1.2s for canary shard. Global will likely follow.
Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: Canary metrics show improvement. Proceeding to global flag rollout in 2m.
Ops Bot: Flag rollout started. `flags rollout streaming.enable_json_mode false --percentage 100 --env prod`
Alex ML: Note: we should diff the template set sizes for affected tenants — a few accounts have >40 tool entries which will still be heavy even with JSON-mode off until caching warms.
Kevin Eng: Deploying the shortcircuit hotfix to remaining pods now. Expecting no schema introspection on paths that exceed threshold.
Maria SRE: Restarting drained pods to pick up patch.
Sam Oncall: Next on-call (Maria) — I'm handing off at 13:05 UTC. Leaving runbook notes: mitigation = scale + flag + hotfix; followups = perf regression PR review, per-tenant template size limits, add telemetry for template expansion work per request.
Customer Success: FYI — notifying affected customers about temporary degraded experience + mitigation steps. Will share list for postmortem.
Kevin Eng: Logged possible root cause: recent template change increased nested tool schema loops; combined with JSON-mode deep introspection produced dramatic CPU/latency growth on prompt construction.
Sam Oncall: Summary timeline: 12:17 alert -> 12:20 scale + canary flag -> 12:24 p99 improved in canary -> 12:28 global flag roll -> 12:35 hotfix rollout + restarts -> 12:38 overall SLOs back within target.
Incident Bot: Severity: Sev2 (customer-impacting latency). Handoff recorded. Please open a postmortem ticket and tag `eng-runtime`, `eng-ml`, `product`.
Maria SRE: Adding quick mitigations to runbook: 1) immediate flag flip for JSON-mode on streaming; 2) scale preproc; 3) fallback model routing for heavy templates; 4) kill/restore misbehaving pods.
Sam Oncall: Thanks team. I'll create the postmortem skeleton and include the list of affected customer IDs, spans, and the PR diff. Leaving channel and marking handoff.
Kevin Eng: Will follow up with a PR to add guardrails in the template compiler and add request-level counters for schema expansion size.
Customer Success: Once postmortem is ready, we'll prepare a customer-facing summary for the impacted accounts.
Incident Bot: Incident archived to timeline. Please add links to PRs, runbooks, and logs to the postmortem ticket.
Maria SRE: Closing my shifts here — monitoring for 30m, will escalate if regressions.
Sam Oncall: Handoff complete.
